value.name: Daniel insists on practical urgency
value.description: Daniel argues that the family must not lose sight of the urgency and that practicality must come first because he is under financial pressure.
evidence: Daniel: "...we can't lose sight of the urgency here—every moment we waste thinking about this house is another moment I risk losing everything I've worked for; practicality has to come first!"
Daniel: "Reflecting on love won't pay the bills, Rosa; we can't afford to romanticize this house while I’m drowning in financial pressure—it's time to make a decision before it's too late."

value.name: Rosa urges reflection on their mother's wishes
value.description: Rosa pushes back against Daniel, asking him to pause and reflect on their mother's wishes and the love that built the home before making a hasty choice.
evidence: Rosa: "Daniel, I understand your urgency, but our mother’s wishes deserve more than a hasty decision; let us pause and reflect on the love that built this home before we allow fear to dictate our choices."

value.name: Rosa proposes uncovering the truth first
value.description: Rosa asks Daniel to seek the truth behind their mother's intentions before deciding what the house means for the family legacy.
evidence: Rosa: "Then let us seek the truth behind her intentions first, Daniel; only then can we decide what this house truly represents—not just for you, but for all of us who carry her legacy."

value.name: Lucia pleads to honor their mother
value.description: Lucia urges Daniel not to make any final decisions yet and says they owe it to their mother to uncover the truth and honor her wishes.
evidence: Lucia: "Please, Daniel, before you make any final decisions, consider that our mother’s love isn’t just a luxury we can afford to overlook—it’s the very foundation of who we are. We owe it to her to uncover the truth and honor her wishes!"

evidence: Rosa: "Lucia is right; our mother's spirit lives in every corner of this house, and before we even think of selling it, we must ensure we understand her true intentions—only then can we truly honor the love she poured into this home."
